assessment: The paper reports several quantitative claims: (1) a long-lived negative photoconductivity with lifetime 17 ps under resonant pumping at 1.476 eV; (2) a short-lived positive response with lifetime ~3 ps for off-resonant pumping; (3) Drude and inverted Lorentz oscillator strengths with decay constants 2.4 ps and 2 ps/15 ps; (4) magnon frequency 1.2 THz with lifetime 70 ps; (5) threshold-saturation behavior of negative spectral weight with pump fluence. The most central and independently abstractable claim is the long-lived negative photoconductivity (negative Δσ1) under resonant pumping, which can be modeled as an inverted Lorentzian with a 17 ps decay. The other claims are either secondary or not sufficiently self-contained for a closed-form oracle. Therefore, one candidate is proposed.
